request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Add only a pattern on the hide: five bold bright amber-orange tiger stripes, colour #f08c1e, across the back and three across the tail, each a thick tapering wedge running down from the spine, few and wide apart. No stripes on the head, belly or legs. Do not redraw anything. Keep the crest, the cream belly, the eyes, teeth, claws, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
